Crowding is not elevated (z=0.9, crowded=false), so no size-down caution is triggered. Lean is a focus expression, not a return forecast.
evidence: rank 1, score 1.655 — relative momentum leadership (attention/focus lens)
durability_bar 0.5, hurst_tag mean-revert — trend health moderate
theses.dissent: The mean-revert Hurst tag on the leader means recent strength may be a local burst rather than a durable trend; with rotation margin only 0.11, leadership could flip quickly, and the focus-rank itself has no forward return edge (rank-IC ~0).

A broad rotation with no one-narrative structure means leadership is contestable, and Oil & Gas is the most plausible near-term challenger if base metals loses momentum.

theses.dissent: Mixed Hurst tag means the trend is not strongly established; score is only slightly above the pack, and the tracking error vs. base metals is small — leadership could flip without warning, and neither theme has validated forward return edge.
